title: OTTplay Android TV
meta_description: Launching OTTplay Premium | 16 OTTs in 1 App | Personalised recommendations
full_description: Are you looking for an app that can solve all your OTT needs? Are you struggling to maintain multiple OTT subscriptions and shuffling between apps?  Your search stops at OTTplay Premium. Not convinced? Just scroll down to find out why we’re so pumped up!  Get 16 OTT platforms in one single app.  * Sony LIV* ZEE5* Lionsgate Play * ShemarooMe * Sun NXT * FUSE+* Tastemade+* Curiosity Stream* manoramaMAX* Hallmark Movies Now * DUST * DocuBay * ShortsTV.* Playflix* Dollywood Play* PTC Play We offer over 25,000 pieces of quality content, both regional and international, through various streaming services personalized to your preferences. From movies to binge-worthy shows, from must-watch short films to gripping documentaries, OTTplay brings you the right mix of edge-of-your-seat bespoke entertainment that will ensure that you always have something new and exciting to watch. There are five packs in total: * Jhakaas (Hindi) -  Zee5, Sony LIV, Shorts TV, Lionsgate Play, ShemarooMe, Dollywood Play, PTC Play, Playflix* Totally Sorted (International) - Curiosity Stream, Hallmark Movies Now, DocuBay, Shorts TV, Tastemade+, Fuse+, Dust, Lionsgate Play* Simply South (South) - Sun NXT, Zee5, manoramaMAX, Lionsgate Play, ShortsTV* Power Play (Premium) - Zee5, SonyLIV,  Lionsgate Play, manoramaMAX, ShemarooMe, Curiosity Stream, Hallmark Movies Now, DocuBay, ShortsTV, Tastemade+, Fuse+, Dust, Sun NXT, Dollywood Play, PTC Play, Playflix* Chhota Patakha (Assorted)- Zee5, Shemaroo Me, ShortsTV, Docubay, Fuse+, PlayflixEach pack is carefully curated to cater to your tastes and preferences. Internationally Yours:  We are launching 4 international OTT platforms in India, for the first time ever! Hallmark Movies Now, FUSE+, Tastemade+, and DUST will be making their debut in India. Not just this, we have other international streaming services, including Curiosity Stream, ShortsTV, Docubay, and LionsgatePlay. A Plethora of Content:  With over 25,000 movies & shows across genres, languages, and categories, you can find yourself experiencing content like never before. From documentaries to live sports, Hollywood to Bollywood, and popular as well as acclaimed TV shows to riveting short films, you can binge them all! Although enriching, this will never be an overwhelming experience because …. Personalised Recommendations:  Our smart recommendation engine handpicks movies and shows that match your taste and language preferences across 65+ OTT platforms, including Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Disney + Hotstar, Zee5, SonyLIV and many more. You will never have to worry about searching for movies and shows ever again! OTTplay will do that for you. It clearly tells WHAT to watch, WHERE to watch, HOW to watch, and even WHEN to watch!Ratings, Reviews, News, Views and more across languages:We not only stream content, we also rate and review it for our users. Our best-in-line editorial team curates the best watching experiences through features, lists, critiques, expert recommendations, in-depth insights and podcasts. We make sure that every OTTPlay viewer is kept abreast with the latest news from the OTTVerse.For any queries, please reach out to us at support@ottplay.comPrivacy Policy: https://www.ottplay.com/privacy-policyTerms of Use: https://www.ottplay.com/terms-of-use
